preconditions.description: The number of clubs m is between 1 and n, and n is at most 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p_i < 5000 for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each student's potential p_i is a non-negative integer less than 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= m for c_i in c)
preconditions.description: Each student's club index c_i is between 1 and m.
The number of days d is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k_i <= n for k_i in k) and len(set(k)) == len(k)
preconditions.description: Each k_i is a unique student index between 1 and n, and no student leaves more than once.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and len(c) == n and len(k) == d
preconditions.description: The input lists p, c, and k have lengths n, n, and d respectively.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= mex <= 5000 for mex in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer representing the mex of the team's potentials.
The output contains exactly d values, one for each day.

postconditions.expression: all(mex == min(set(range(5000)) - set(selected_potentials)) for mex, selected_potentials in zip(output, team_potentials))
postconditions.description: For each day, the output mex is the smallest non-negative integer not present in the selected team's potentials, where the team is formed by selecting one student from each non-empty club after the students who left have been removed.

postconditions.expression: all(mex == max(possible_mex for possible_mex in possible_mex_values) for mex, possible_mex_values in zip(output, possible_mex_values_list))
postconditions.description: For each day, the output mex is the maximum possible mex achievable by selecting one student from each non-empty club after the students who left have been removed.
